doc.title: Chuck Israels interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2021

title: Whether he wishes he'd lived in another era
summary: Israels has never thought about it and feels lucky to have had his career when he did.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: And you’ll have to play it every night. Are you happy with the — this is an odd question but your music has gone places that probably you and I wish it hadn’t. Would you have been happier if your career had started when Red Mitchell’s did.
Okay well then my timing’s off. But were there eras of music that you wish you had participated in? Earlier on?
I never thought about it. I haven’t thought about that. Huh. My mother used to say, “What if there were no hypothetical questions?” Think about that.
Let me get back to you on that, okay? © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-

It hasn’t occurred to me. I feel tremendously lucky to have had, to have been born and to have had my artistic life happen when it happened. Had it happened a little bit earlier maybe that would have been good but then I wouldn’t be alive now talking to you so —
